title: BIRDMisc 32bF Cockatoo
author: dhi67540
changes: Sulphur-crested cockatoo (Cacatua galerita) giving two raucous screeches as it moves away from the recordist. Trimmed to 16.75–19.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The more distant calls near the end of the recording were chosen because they are softer than the close-up screeches.
